name: Venture Co. Mine
summary: In Mulgore’s eastern cliffs, Venture Co. Mine scars land the tauren hold sacred. The goblin company digs without permission, disturbing the plains’ natural balance.

sections.title: Unwanted Industry
sections.body: The Venture Company tunnels through Mulgore’s eastern mountain wall, though the tauren refused it mining rights. Supervisor Fizsprocket directs the work. Three entrances lead inside: a ground tunnel guarded by hired muscle, a cliffside overlook, and an upper passage to a small lumber camp. Machines, smoke, and slag heaps scar land the tauren hold sacred.

sections.title: Expanding Ambitions
sections.body:
The Venture Company means to expand beyond mining. Mogul Razdunk and the company’s board urged Fizsprocket to begin large-scale timber harvesting, promising advanced goblin shredders to clear the rolling hills.

Tauren Outrunners attacked and burned a company supply caravan near Stonebull Lake’s northern shore to delay the expansion. Salvagers soon went to recover its cargo. Now the tribes target the mine’s supervisors directly.

faq.q: Why are goblins mining in Mulgore?
faq.answer: The Venture Company wants minerals from Mulgore, but the tauren refused permission. The cartel ignores their territorial claims and the land’s balance, sending workers and machines into the eastern cliffs to plunder the hills.

faq.q: Who is in charge of this mining site?
faq.answer: Supervisor Fizsprocket directs Venture Company operations in Mulgore from his post inside the main entrance. He takes orders from the company’s executive board and Mogul Razdunk.

faq.q: What happened to the supply caravan by the lake?
faq.answer: Tauren Outrunners ambushed and burned a Venture Company supply caravan near Stonebull Lake’s northern shore to keep machinery from reaching the mine. Goblin salvage teams soon searched the wreckage for the company’s goods.

faq.q: What else do the goblins plan to build here?
faq.answer: Beyond mining ore from the cliffs, the company plans a lumber mill and shredders to clear Mulgore’s trees for profit.

angles.text: As a tauren, you know the mine insults the Earth Mother. Its soot, noise, and scars mark ancestral valleys your tribes have sworn to protect.
As an engineer, you can find Twizwick Sprocketgrind beyond the mine tunnels and through the higher lumber clearing. He shares mechanical trade secrets away from corporate eyes.
